title: Validation of Ultra Sound (US) Elastography
brief_summary: This is a prospective, single-center, non-randomised, non-blinded trial with US Elastography of Patients referred to our institution to assess soft tissue and organ lesions. All patients will undergo next to the clinical indicated conventional US-examination, US Elastography after informed consent. After completion of these three examinations, the participation in the study is completed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient scheduled for clinically indicated conventional Ultrasound examination

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 years
study_population: Patient scheduled for clinically indicated conventional Ultrasound examination
